      Methods in net.canarymod.database with parameters of type DataAccess 
      Modifier and Type Method and Description
      abstract void Database.insert(DataAccess data)
      Insert the given DataAccess object as new set of data into database
      abstract void Database.load(DataAccess dataset, Map<String,Object> filters)
      This method will fill your DataAccess object with the first data set from database, that matches the given values in the given fields.
      For instance if you pass String[] {"score", "name"}
      with respective values Object[] {130, "damagefilter"},
      Canary will look in the database for records where score=130 and name=damagefilter.
      Canary will only look in the table with the name you have set in your AccessObject
      abstract void Database.loadAll(DataAccess typeTemplate, List<DataAccess> datasets, Map<String,Object> filters)
      Loads all results that match the field - values given into a DataAccess list.
      abstract void Database.remove(DataAccess da, Map<String,Object> filters)
      Removes the data set from the given table that suits the given field names and values.
      abstract void Database.removeAll(DataAccess da, Map<String,Object> filters)
      Removes the data set from the given table that suits the given field names and values.
      abstract void Database.update(DataAccess data, Map<String,Object> filters)
      Updates the record in the database that fits to your fields and values given.
      abstract void Database.updateAll(DataAccess template, Map<DataAccess,Map<String,Object>> data)
      Updates the records in the database that fits to your fields and values given.
      abstract void Database.updateSchema(DataAccess schemaTemplate)
      Updates the database table fields for the given DataAccess object.
